text:
Update: dead at 16 months; I liked it while it lasted...hard to have servicerd

I am in love with this dishwasher; it has saved me from the drudgery of hand washing dishes (along with chapped cracked hands). I cannot say enough good things about this dishwasher; it fits nicely on my counter top and underneath the cabinets, ample capacity – read the outside dimensions people! This thing is not a TARDIS there is no way it's going to be bigger on the inside than it is on the outside. The capacity it as basically the top rack of a smaller dishwasher. It took me a little while to get use to loading, but now I have the hang of it.

I researched a lot before making my purchase;

1 year warranty (much better than some countertop dishwashers I looked at) along with the extended warranty provided by my credit card and an additional 2 months added to the warranty provided by Danby, just take the short questionnaire on the Danby website – 22 month warranty, WOW!

Quality company

Good repair history versus some of the popular Asian brands
Looked nice. Unfortunately it did not work as it had an internal leak and had to be returned. Would not buy again.
easy to install, cleans great, very quiet, so glad that i purchased it
Just what I needed. Work's perfect.
so easy to hook up, can fill a lot of dishes. so easy to use. We are getting a new baby in our house soon. Perfect for bottles. What a good investment.

This model is much better than the DDW497 I replaced. The DDW621 is *far* quieter and cleans items in the dishwasher noticeably better.

There is one negative point. The left side has a pair of adjustable/removable shelves. In the DDW497, the comparable shelf was just low enough to allow a second set of cups to be on that shelf (four cups/tall glasses on the lower rack and four 9-oz coffee cups on the upper shelf). The two shelves in the DDW621 are set too high to permit this. They will not allow the same 9-oz cups (Correlle) to be on those shelves because they hit the top of the front opening when you try to roll it into the dishwasher. If you move the racks down, then there is no room for the same-sized cups under those shelves. I checked other coffee cups (8-9 oz capacity, not just Correlle), and they all experienced the same problem. This is a design flaw in the rack, not in the dishwasher. I was able to fit a small (20-oz) casserole onto the top shelf, with its lid on the other top shelf.

I mostly use Correlleware, and I have been using it for some time (30+yrs). The largest plates (12") will NOT fit. All the other stuff will fit with few problems.

Important note: The dishwasher stopped working in July 2019. Everything is connected, but no water flow into the unit. Seems to be an internal pump failure, as there is good water pressure from the faucet and the hoses are clear (not blocked or kinked).

KEY POINT: I have just look

Such a time saver for me! With 4 of us here, it's just the right size to keep up the dishes by running a load at night =) I hate washing the dishes because it hurts my hands, and this was the perfect solution! They only issues that I have with it is that even with the rinse aid, it doesn't get all of the soap off of the plates, but that's easily solved but a quick wipe with a damp rag; and I can't put a cup in the back left corner because they just won't get clean. Other than those very minor issues, it's been beautiful. Included everything I needed to install, and was a fairly easy set-up.
Arrived broken. Had to return.

Unfortunately, from my research on countertop dishwashers, this is the best of the bunch. It appears as though all countertops are manufactured by the same manufacturer, and then just appointed with slightly different electronics and faces to suit each re-branding OEM's needs. They're all almost exactly the same size, there's only about 2 or 3 variations on the racks, and they all appear to have the same door/port placement. We had a Danby Designer before this and it recently gave up the ghost after 12 years of faithful service. I now wish we would have repaired that one, because none of the current models are anywhere near as good as that thing was.

The Pros:
* This is the only model with a heater built in. *However,* it doesn't really get that hot at 165F. Our last model had to settings for heat-- normal and hot-- and the hot setting would essentially steam everything away and scortch your hand if you touched glasses coming directly out after a cycle.
* Quiet. I was honestly surprised by how quiet this thing is, and it's been probably the best feature improvement over older models.
* Able to accommodate the tallest plates from all the other versions offered.
* Has various settings (but, really, you're only going to use one or two).

Cons:
* Still not tall enough. Our last Danby Designer could easily hold our 11" dinner plates with room to spare. Now, if we want the dinner plates to be washed, we either have to put them
This is nice and also quiet. The dishwasher makes doing a set of dishes quick and easy.
This is nice and also quiet. The dishwasher makes doing a set of dishes quick and easy.
It's fantastic I can't believe that something small could do so much. Above and beyond my expectations
It came with the door latch snapped off, but I glued it with some e-6000. It works great.
What a great little machine!  I couldn't be any happier with it!

Works as expected.  It isn't very loud and I've not seen a marked increase in my electric bill.  I do wish it were a little taller so my full sized plates would fit in it, however, the plates are bigger than normal.
Fine for casual use/removal of crumbs, but does not get stuck on foods or heavy duty washing done, at all. Rack is also a little difficult to load at times.

The dishwasher worked fine for a few days, but in less than a week it stopped working completely. I contacted Danby for support and they said that the unit needed to be fixed. I would have to take the dishwasher to the closest repair center (which is not in my city) for the repairs. Instead I contacted Amazon and I am returning the unit for a full refund. I am so glad Amazon's customer service is so much better than Danby's.

Best purchase EVER... it works great and has way more room than you would imagine!!  Perfect for my husband and I. Don't use pods in it liquid only n not much 1/2 or less n don't over fill it make sure water from bottom can reach all dishes n it works perfectly. The pods don't dissolve n can ruin it BUT it works GREAT otherwise!!

Lived without a dishwasher for 14 years because my I couldn't afford to lose cabinet space in my kitchen.  I finally gave up counter space in a corner because I HATE to do dishes.  Did my research on countertop dishwashers, decided that this was my best bet, and couldn't be happier!  Very, very quiet, cleans well, and I only use it every 4-5 days since I live alone.  It saves water, is good on electric bill, and I don't have to do dishes!
Item arrived damaged and did not work. Package appeared ok, but product was clearly mishandled at some point.
I call her my wife! She does a GREAT job cleaning dishes!
Product arrived with 2 dents and a scuff.  I am not happy.

Love, love this portable dishwasher!!!!!
It does an excellent job of washing dishes, pot, utensils etc. just like a full size dishwasher. Hook up was very easy plus it came with all the connectors described in the features. Quiet machine just right for my family. Arrived on time plus packaged very well, highly recommend.
I'm in an RV a lot. With age my eyesight is not what it used to be and poor lighting doesn't help.  This dishwasher is awesome.  I don't think it could do better than it does. The
Agitator arm stopped working after 2 years use.
If you never owned a dishwasher by this it is amazing for the price. Although I would say it kind of fits only like two people dish

I absolutely love my new Danby Countertop Dishwasher. It arrived actually the day before it was originally scheduled. There were two small things wrong at first. The cutlery container handle was broken and the quick connect piece that went into the faucet had a problem. I called Amazon and they immediately rectified the situation above and beyond what I expected. The dishwasher is quiet, cleans the dishes really well and my 10.5 Corelle plates fit just right. It also fits the stainless steel  interior of my Instant Pot.  I use a liquid dishwasher cleanser instead of the pods as they contain too much detergent for this small unit. I also use the Finish Rinse as recommended. I do rinse the dishes off before putting them in there just to get the bigger pieces of food off. There is a filter in the bottom that will catch anything but so far it has been clean when I open it. I have tried a couple of settings and one of them took a long time (over an hour) but the regular one takes about an hour. It has a heater that heats the water. DON"T forget to turn off the faucet when trying to uncouple the quick release. I forgot the first time. Also I crack open the door a little when it is done so it dries everything nicely. As a single person living in a small apartment, this is exactly whet I was looking for. Thank you Danby/Amazon.

Love it! Came well boxed and shipped super fast. This little beast is very quiet and holds a surprising amount of dishes. Perfect for our limited space aituation. So go ahead, press that buy button! You will thank me for it! Updated 3/20/18 STILL LOVE THIS MACHINE
Love it! It's a little bigger than I expected but still compact, very easy instructions, quick set up, and holds a lot more dishes than you might think.

If there was a way to give this product negative stars, I would do it.  Warning to all Amazon shoppers - Do not buy this product.  Not only did this little machine break down after less than 3 weeks, but Danby's customer service is the worst I have ever had the misfortune to deal with.  When I first hooked it up, I loved this little dishwasher.  I was so happy to finally get something that would fit my tiny kitchen and it worked really well.  Then one day, it started beeping and flashing lights.  I opened it and noticed the detergent cup did not open.  I thought this to be no big deal and restarted the machine.  It was okay for another couple of days and then the same problem.  This time the problem did not go away.  by this time, we had just past the point of returning it to Amazon so we contacted Danby.  What followed has been nothing but a run around from them.  We were told to take it to an authorized repair shop who had the product for over two weeks and not able to fix it or even diagnose it.  We asked Danby to intercede and help but to no avail.  When I called, I was told to email.  When I emailed, I got not reply so I had to follow up with a call. At this point, I have given Danby by email everything they have asked for but I still do not have a working dishwasher or a refund.  I am ready to eat the loss of the money I have spent and put it in the trash but I just don't think that is fair.  All I want is a dishwasher that actually works and keeps working for more than
Easy to use, loading it takes practice with my larger plates and bowls. Cleans well and is quiet. Bought it for a small kitchen in a rental to be installed under counter.

UPDATE: this broke a month or two later. The company sent us a replacement unit that also failed a few months after that. Do not recommend buying this.

We love this dishwasher. It is our first portable dishwasher, and we've used it heavily for the 4 months we've owned it. It cleans like a champ. We can even stack plates pretty close together and it cleans them well. We will often end up running it one or two times a day to get through all the dishes we use. It saves us a ton of time and work at home.

It is...as you might notice...small. It's a bit like playing Tetris to see how many dishes you can fit in there (as is the case with all dishwashers). Bigger items like pots and pans we still do by hand. Also, our big dinner plates will not fit in this machine straight up and down. For the most part, we just use the smaller plates we have.

We usually just run it on the "normal" mode, which takes about 75-90min I think. It feels a bit long. There are faster modes to be used, but we haven't experimented with those, for fear that they won't clean as well. We use little detergent pods from Costco, and Jet Dry rinse agent, and it does a good job.

Overall, we have no buyers remorse for getting this. It's been a great buy.

Item came with several small dents, scrapes, and paint chipped off, and what looked like water scale residue inside as well as water in the intake valve area which indicates to me that the product wasn't new. Product was returned.

After three months of multiple times a wee use I have been pleasantly surprised by this countertop dishwasher. If you keep your expectations reasonable you will be very happy with it.

Like other reviewers have stated, all of the countertop dishwashers on Amazon all come from the same factory and have the same innards, shop on price and looks. In my case, having a rental house away from home for a one year appointment, looks didn’t really matter. The Danby plain white one with push button controls is perfect.

No, this won’t wash your stock pot or large sauce pan (maybe the sauce pan and some utinsels by themselves). However, for the day to day 90%? It’s great. It will wash all of your utensils, plates (even big oversized American dinner plates), mugs bowls and glassware.

Simply replace the nozzle on your sink faucet and clip on the hose when you want to use it.

This does take a good amount of counter top space, but fits underneath cabinets. In my 1950s era rental with original cabinets it clears them with a few centimeters to spare in height, and a few centimeters front to back. If you put a large toaster oven and a drip brew coffee maker side by side it would take up similar horizontal space.

The inside is stainless steel with plastic coated metal wire trays that seem very high quality.

Cleaning quality is on par with $4-500 price range standard dishwashers. Yes, it’s probably best if you rinse your dishes thou
Excellent product, works well in the camper.

I LOVE my Danby!! Fits under the counter and gets my dishes sparkling clean. The first dishwasher I’ve seen that lets you adjust the rinse agent. Turned it down one notch and no more residue in my plastics!! Awesome!!
easy install and fast delivery.

This is roomy and works beautifully period completely easy to set up once I figure it out that you can attach it to the sink with a quick attach piece either on the outside or the inside of the threading. I did get a little confused had to watch a YouTube video and then realize that the threading for a smaller sink is on the inside portion covered up by the washers. Other than that it attached easily

Update: We pretty much stopped using this mini counter washer. Not because it doesn't work well. It works great and has good settings and easy operation. The problem is that it doesn't fit many dishes at all. Mostly good for silverware since it can fit a lot of those small items. Takes a minimum of 2 hours to wash. You could wash the amount of dishes that it holds in about 1/4th that time and use FAR less water/power. It's a great product. Just doesn't make much sense to use though when you think about it. Now we're stuck with a huge $250 brick on our counter. Hopefully we can sell it at least.

Just received it today and used it for the first time. We are so glad that we have a dishwasher and don't have to do dishes anymore!! It is super quiet and saves on water. This is great for small kitchens or to bring and use in an RV. Installation is very straight forward. But DO MAKE SURE you have a faucet that this attachment to

Moved into a new place with a small sink and no dishwasher, had an agreement with the wife that if she did the laundry, i'd hand wash all the dishes. I bought this the next day and she called me a cheater. It's very easy to use, setup is simple, it's quiet, very efficient, and holds a bit more than I expected. I absolutely love this dishwasher, although it's a bit of an eyesore on the counter, and is about two inches too wide to fit underneath the sink. If you are looking for a quality dishwasher for an inexpensive price, look no further.
Bought it, connected tight by instruction but immediately started to leak from front door. It cleans good but had to return it because of a leak.

I've wanted one of these for years now, and  my roommate was adamant about not needing one. Lol! I just load it through the day and after my last meal of the day, I run it. 1.5 - 2 hours later, I put dishes away and get ready to sleep. I love having a clean kitchen every morning.
Good little dishwasher but there is some assembly required. There is no where to store the hoses when it’s not in use. Other than that it’s nice. Some of my larger plates will not fit in it.

I am impressed so far! It is NOT a large dishwasher but it does the job very well for me. I did purchase the extended warranty as I think having insurance on this is a no brainer. UPDATE: July 15th 2018, this dishwasher is an excellent purchase! I am very happy and wonder why I waited so long to buy it.I have had ZERO issues with this dishwasher. I did purchase the extended warranty and have said that before. More than a month later I am throwing my dishes at it and it is chugging along. I do empty or rinse the dishes well before loading, I always have. I wanted this because of the sanitizing effect that dishwashers provide. This has really done the job! I have seen ZERO dirty dishes after washing. I did attach the drain and the water line directly to the underneath of the sink, doing so was not easy because the connections are not standard size, but after three days of running back and forth to the hardware store it is all good and works great like a normal under counter dishwasher. Not a single leak or any noise or other issues to complain of. I really like this and wanted to share with those of you that might be tormenting yourself by continuing to hand wash those dishes, buy this you'll be happy and you can relax while technology cleans up after you!

Not the best but does its job. Make sure you don't press the delay timer button, because I thought that was a wash duration option but it's not 😂😂 If you're worried about the longevity of the item just get the 2 year protection with Amazon. It's pretty cheap and worth it for something over 200 bucks.
love this thing works great!

I have a small kitchen plus I just wasn't ready for a full scale remodel with new cabinets etc. This was the perfect compromise. It's just my husband & I.  Usually our dirty dishes consist mostly of cups & glasses. This little machine is working great for that so far. Had it a couple months & no problems so far.

I adore this. I've been without a dishwasher for 5+ years, this was my birthday present to myself. It's a little bulkier than I expected - it's essentially the same footprint as a normal dishwasher, it's just one "drawer" height. Easy hookup (once I finally wrestled the aerator out of my faucet). I like that it has different wash settings. I pre-rinse my dishes as I use them anyhow, so the light settings work great.
Works great I love it
I am a single guy and this is perfect for me. I am not afraid to cook now because I just throw the pans and stuff into the dishwasher. the next day I put away clean dry dishes

Great little machine, runs well and quiet. A little smaller than expected, dinner plates are difficult to put in, (not like the picture) but with alittle getting used to it's fine. I ordered an adapter for it but there wasn't a need to, it came with it attached already. It was packed well, no dents. Well worth the money for a small mobile dishwasher.
it dosnt clean the dishes very poor
I love it. I live by myself and it is just perfect for me.
Amazing I love it
So far, works great. Dishes get very clean.
Works great.  Slightly larger than a large microwave.  Layout makes loading a bit of a challenge until you get use to it.
So far very pleased with this item

I want to start by saying, my first one came in damaged from shipment but that's not this products fault. Amazon sent UPS to my door to pick up the product and sent me another one. This thing works great! I've put 4 loads of dishes through it so far, and it's awesome! Obviously it's not for huge pots and pans, just mostly regular dishes and it cleans well. Open the door when it's done and your dishes will be dry within minutes.

Was easy to connect. Was quieter than I thought it would be. Did a very good job. The only thing negative was there a slight leak at the connection to the sink so I could not set it for delayed wash or it would waste too much UPDATE: I rechecked my connection to the faucet and adjusted it and now it works perfectly there's no leaking water. So I'm using the timer now.

What an awesome little machine!
It hooked up to my sink easily. It fits snugly on my counter. It doesn’t dry very well but I don’t mind it.
All you need included, works awesome 30-45 min wash time, squeaky clean dishes.

The one drawback to this product that unique to me was that the intake and drain water hoses were not long enough.  I needed the extra length due to the layout of my tiny apartment kitchen.  I tried contacting Danby customer service and even though the answering agent was nice to me the manager I spoke to was belidgerant.  They do NOT sell extension hoses for the singular reason of, “it wouldn’t work properly.”  That answer is a bunch of crap and they know it. I tried looking for similar hoses at the hardware store near me but low and behold the fittings for the hoses that come with the product are custom made so that you can’t add an additional hose to the machine.  I had to go to a specialty store several towns over to find anything that would fit and had to make 2 separate extension hoses from scratch.  Other than this blatant atempt to thwart any additions to their machinery the product works well. I just hate washing dishes by hand.
Perfect for one person easy hookup wish it had a way to hookup the hot water line under the counter instead of one option to sink faucet

this is very good machine, much better than i thought.  ive been using this as i await my kitchen to be finish and we use it every day.  its not for heavy duty cleaning but its great for wine glasses, coffee mugs and cereal bowls.  you need to add the rinse aid and then you have clean dishes and glasses.  has a short 20 min cycle for glasses that is great.  easy to set up and comes with all the hook up items.

I wish I had read this review before I purchased this dishwasher. I had Danby’s Previous model and it worked perfectly for 14 years. After it finally died, I decided to purchase the same brand. This one is nothing like the original, and certainly is not an improved model. It is slow and does clean particularly well. The door does not lie flat, so the rack stays on a slant. It makes it almost impossibly to load or unload it easily as the rack keeps rolling back into the machine. Dishes do not fit well, even though they are the same dishes that I washed in the other model. It also leaks- not a flood, but enough to have to keep a towel next to the machine to wipe up the water. I contacted Danny through their website and they didn’t even bother to respond

Very satisfied works well the only problem is our very large plates have a hard time fitting in it but we just turned a slight sideways and they fit well. Alot bigger then I was thinking which is good. Fits perfect on my counter. Wish I had realized it came up with its own sink Hook-Ups because I bought an extra oops but that's okay!! Hook up fits right onto our kitchen faucet perfect! The only thing I don't like about it is there's no words on what the functions do on it you have to read the manual.
Works well if you have your water at 125 deg. and use liquid dishwasher detergent.

Did 2 loads of dishes so far. This thing is AMAZING I used the mid grade of the cascade packs and I do believe what dish detergent you use matters. I had a bowl with melted chocolate in it from 2 days ago (no judging lol) that bowl is SPOTLESS I'm super impressed. Extremely quiet. It leaks a little at the faucet I've tightened everything best I can it's tiny drip doesn't seem to be causing any issues though. I have depression some days I wanna wash every dish in the house by hand some days it takes all I have just to take a shower. Some people made fun of me for this purchase but this will be a life saving game changer for me

I got this in the other day and I have only used it once, that said it was easy to hook up and seems to work fine. My only complaint is that the sink adapter looks like it has an aerator but it does no aeration at all. Anyone know of a good alternative adapter that  does aerate?

It works really good the only reasons I am a little dissatisfied is because it won't fit under standard cabinets its too tall for most people's cabinets by their sink so I had to put it on a rolling cart and roll it all the way to the bathroom to get it to hook up to the sink in there because it wouldn't fit any of the faucets in my house I had to modify the bathroom faucet just so I could use it I don't feel like I'm getting my money's worth I will probably sell it
Works very well

This item was a waste of my time, my money, and a 3 loads of laundry for all the towels I had to use cleaning up the messes it made.  I got one and it leaked.  Filed a complaint and got a second one which ALSO LEAKED.  This item is garbage.  But another model.  Don’t waste your time or effort or money on this one.

I bought this dishwasher to make my share of the chores a little easier and it works perfectly in that respect. It fits nicely right on the counter in our little kitchen and connects intuitively to the sink without any issues. The instructions and user manual are very easy to understand, and it even breaks down the water and energy usuages for each of the cycles.

I have used it a couple of times to play catch up and thoroughly clean those items that hand-washing didn't meet my expectations and it has far exceeded them. It is quiet and seems to be efficient. I'd recommend this highly for anyone in a similar situation as I am; wanting to lighten the load of hand-washing dishes with limited space.

Only used 6 times and in that sixth time it leaked from the bottom somewhere. The connections were all dry, the faucet area all dry, but full water all over underneath the unit, down my cabinet and all over the floor all while I'm trying to get ready for our Christmas. Very disappointed.

We actually bought this for the trailer we've had to move into after a fire in our home. At first it was kind of a lark but the machine turns out to be pretty awesome. Some of the cycles can take up to an hour and a half but it is really quiet (to the  point, where at first, I kept opening it to see if it was actually working - it was). It cleans dishes, glasses and flatware beautifully and sterilizes them. The downside is, well, it's a countertop dishwasher so it doesn't fit large dishes or pots. But circumstances being what they are, while we are rebuilding, this dishwasher is a lifesaver and I am tickled with my purchase!
Easy set up.

We use this as a second dishwasher for our cat dishes. It is quiet and gets the dishes really clean. We are a Danby repeat customer and I can highly recommend their dishwashers. This little dishwasher holds a surprising amount of dishes. I have to say again, it is very, very quiet. Our old Danby from 2004 was an 18" portable and sounded like a thunderstorm. But worked superbly for years. We are even more pleased with this new one.

This is the first countertop dishwasher I have seen. What a great idea. It fits perfectly on my counter taking up no more room than the draining board it replaced.
And does it ever clean! On the light wash setting my dishes and glasses came out spotless. It used very little water compared to hand washing and it is very, very quiet. I had to really listen to see if it was running.
The size is perfect for small households of 1-3 people. It is as easy as sitting it on your counter and plugging it in. The adapter for the sink faucet is included and it's adaptable to fit male or female threads. Two minuets and your ready to wash a pile of dishes.
Now the only thing I found I didn't like were the little shelves that were meant for coffee cups. I use mugs. No, they don't fit and they are in the way. But hey, they are removable! And that's what I did.
Bottom line, it's an amazing find and half the price of the bulky roll around.
I would say jump on this deal. I've had much larger dishwashers that didn't clean any better than this one.

Although the size of the unit limits the size of plates and other dishes to be washed, I am very happy with the dishwasher. It works well and leaves my dishes clean and mush more sterile than hand-washing. I do recommend using dishwasher powder as opposed to using dish washing liquid.

My wife absolutely loves this thing. It's surprisingly spacious, quiet and so far it's been really durable. I love the quick access connectors and the slim design. I don't like the  controls and there's no visual timer on it to show you exactly how much time is left. However, those aren't bad enough to outweigh the good. Solid buy.

I did not buy mine through Amazon but through home depot. This little machine is wonderful and it works great. I love it. So if you go through Amazon or another place this product will last for years. It is awesome. Danby is the best to buy.
This dishwasher does not wash well or rinse clean. Don't waste your money.

Fits perfectly on a standard metal rolling cart you can buy at anywhere. I just rolled it to the sink and hooked it when I need to then roll it back against the wall when done. Then it doesn't take up no room on my counter. Perfect size for just me and my husband. No more dishes for these hands. ❤❤

(UPDATE) 3/11/21: Dishwasher still functions 100%! We had to replace the adapter that came with it but that was due to a user error in removing the adapter from the faucet itself. We do need to replace the dish tray through the manufacturer (already found Danby's website with fairly reasonable parts) but that's on us because we use the heck out of this machine. We run it almost every night. It's just my boyfriend and myself but we cook with fresh ingredients, so in turn, more dirty dishes/utensils (we wash it ALL in this little thing, except the cast iron of course). I will use distilled white vinegar once a month in a tiny ramekin to clean it while using jet dry and finish quantum detergent in every wash. I will tell ya, you get your money's worth and more with this machine! Just take care of it.

1/13/19: I moved into a small apartment with no dishwasher and was getting tired of hand washing (I've not had one). So I bought this since the price was reasonable and the reviews were good. I bought a little kitchen cart with a wood top so I can roll it up to the sink and not have it take up all my counter space. It does what I expected and I especially like the delayed start so it finishes by the time I get home from work. It's fairly quiet and I can start it at bedtime and sleep through it.
This worked great for 3 years, then stopped draining. FRUSTRATING!!!

We bought this as a gift for my brother-in-law who just moved into an apartment with no dishwasher.  As soon as we got it out of the box we loaded it with the lunch dishes and turned it on.  It did an amazing job!  Everything was sparkling clean.  It does everything a larger built-in dishwasher does (multiple cycle options, including a rinse only so food doesn't dry on the dishes), a delay timer for 2, 4, 6, or 8 hours.  The only thing it doesn't do is heat dry the dishes, but if you follow the instructions, when it beeps turn it off, disconnect from faucet, and open the door, the dishes air dry after a few minutes and you can put them away.  It sits on the counter top and connects to the kitchen faucet with an adapter that's included.  If you load as the diagram shows, it cleans a lot of dishes for its size.  It's perfect for a bachelor who hates dishwashing!

My built in stopped working, so I bought this.  It mostly does what it's supposed to do.  Be careful of which setting you use, since a few of them do absolutely nothing.  I think I use the one that looks like it has a wine glass on it, and all the dishes come up clean.  It is louder than I thought it would be, especially when it ejects the water.  Overall, happy with purchase, since I was getting tired of washing dishes all the time.
Perfect for my mobile home. Very quiet and cleans dishes very well. Glad I brought it.

Had I known that these existed I'd have gotten one sooner. I bought one as soon as I found these. No regrets. This machine looks nice and well made. Came well packed. Not sure what kind of cups are supposed to fit on the top shelf? I'm guessing if you don't have room under your countertop for a normal dishwasher, you're not going to have room on top of your countertop either. I'm not quite sure how heavy it is, but it's too big and heavy to casually pick it up and move it around.

You're going to want a cart to wheel this thing out of your way when you're not using it, and the hoses will dribble water everywhere when you do. To keep the floor dry, I put a plastic wash basin on the shelf under it and coiled the hose into it when not it use.

Four months in and I'm still highly satisfied with this little dishwasher. With the included quick connect on the faucet it's pretty simple once you figure it all out.

Read the manual!! Theres a couple of awesome little options and information packed in that booklet. I referred to it often in the first month while ironing out the quirks. My issue was basically I didnt tighten the things on the back well enough, but once I got that figured out it's been smooth sailing.

Couple of other notes:
make sure not to lay down long cooking utensils in the wrong spot, they will hang below the loading rack and stop the spinner on the bottom resulting in a bad wash.

Power on before water on!
Water off and red button on faucet connect before you remove it!
Make sure the hose from the faucet is going to spray into an empty sink when the dishwasher drains, it sprays hard and can soak the counter of it blasts off of dirty dishes that didnt fit.

Easy install, still running great after a year or so.

Nearing two years of consistent use, still running perfectly.

In the time that it was working, the dishwasher was great! It was a powerful little dishwasher and cleaned my dishes well. After about three washes, the machine began stopping mid cycle and beep. Each time the detergent dispenser remained closed. I checked the hose, looked for kinking, and made sure the water source was on. I even removed the hose to look for obstructions. I tried to run the dishwasher empty for further assessment and the machine continued to beep mid cycle and flash for hours with the detergent door closed.

It was an annoying experience. I returned it without hassles which was nice. But now I'm on the search for a reliable dishwasher.
